purpose: Keep the axial-stretch/core-radius geometry of the frozen ST052-M outer-reservoir correction channel separate from total-child behavior, public-source numerical claims, visual correspondence, and PDE acceptance.

related_governance.nonduplication: PR #783 governs whether project-selected z/r/time visual-development coordinates can be mislabeled as public OpenAI numbers. This contract instead governs whether PR #785 correction-channel geometry can be mislabeled as total-child geometry or source/visual/PDE evidence.

user_requirement: Deliver an explicit callable/saveable time-varying 3D velocity field velocity(x,y,z,t)->[u,v,w].
Make publicly observable field structure as consistent as practicable with the public OpenAI visualization while keeping source, visual, and PDE claims separate.
public_source_fact: Axial stretching/elongation is an admitted qualitative public observable in the separate public-observable authority.
No public numerical core radius, core-area fraction, repository radial coordinate, or correction-channel axial sign-change radius is admitted here.
autonomous_design: The correction-channel vector-potential form A=(-y*f,x*f,0) with f=R(r^2)Z(z).
The radial profile proportional to ((q+1)*(64/25-q))^4 and correction support radius r<1.6.
The unit-channel axial response C_z/Z=2*(R+q*R_q), its polynomial sign equation -225*q^2+195*q+64=0, and the resulting r-star/core-area geometry.
The |z|=1.55 and radii 0.6,0.9,1.2,1.5 live probe choices.
The 5001/20001/80001 radial-grid numerical mirror of the full-disk signed axial-flux identity.
pending_unknown: Whether the total nonlinear #775 child has the same axial sign-change radius after adding the parent field and frozen child coefficient.
Any public numerical core radius or core-area fraction corresponding to the OpenAI visualization.
Any physical/source scale map identifying repository r-star with a public-render length scale.
Global visual correspondence of the candidate field, including camera/projection/time registration.
Hidden OpenAI field samples, coefficients, pressure, forcing, and exact field identity.

pr785_pass_may_support: The frozen correction representation contains a repository-defined unit-response mechanism with visible-band inward radial correction and core-away-from-midplane axial correction on the preregistered probes.
The correction channel has the stated internal radial sign geometry and full-disk signed axial-flux balance.
pr785_pass_does_not_support: The total #775 child has axial stretch at every point where the correction channel does.
The total #775 child core radius equals the correction-channel r-star.
The total candidate has zero axial flux because the correction channel has zero axial flux.
The numerical r-star/core-area fraction is sourced from OpenAI.
Global or independent visual correspondence is verified.
Navier-Stokes PDE acceptance, paper-exact recovery, exact OpenAI-field identity, or blow-up proof.
stronger_total_child_claim_requires: Freeze the exact child identity and coefficient before evaluation.
Evaluate parent plus frozen correction rather than the unit correction channel alone.
Preregister total-field probes or a disjoint fixed-render protocol before observing the result.
Do not use the evaluation evidence to retune the same child and then relabel it independent.
